name: VeriSwarm Guard
description: Trust scoring, PII tokenization, policy enforcement, and audit for OpenClaw agents. Protects against data exposure, prompt injection, and unauthorized tool usage.

agentId.description: Agent ID for this OpenClaw instance

agentKey.description: Agent API key (agta_...) for credential issuance and self-reporting

piiEnabled.description: Enable PII tokenization on outbound messages and tool-call params

injectionScan.description: Enable prompt injection scanning on tool outputs

auditEnabled.description: Enable audit logging to VeriSwarm Vault

allowedTools.description: Only these tools allowed (allowlist mode). Empty = allow all.

secretsDetection.description: Scan outbound tool-call args for provider-prefix secrets. On a hit, tokenize via the API when online, or redact locally (fail-closed) when offline. Default off.

sessionScan.description: Enable Session Sentry multi-turn exfiltration detection. Each outbound message is submitted to /v1/suite/guard/scan-session; if the conversation-level risk score triggers a block, delivery of the message is cancelled. Fail-open: any API error is logged and the message is sent unmodified. Safe to leave on while the platform flag is dormant — the server returns {enabled:false, blocked:false}. Default: true.
